findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: qc_contractor_check, extract_url, qc_licence, pkg_meta, homework_check, web_search, company_enrich, payment_check, sanctions_check · Private data: company_enrich, payment_check · Public sink: summarize, translate, extract, extract_url, qc_licence, pkg_meta, homework_check, verify_business, web_search, company_enrich, company_fit, payment_check, sanctions_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: qc_contractor_check, extract_url, qc_licence, pkg_meta, homework_check, web_search, company_enrich, payment_check, sanctions_check · Private data: company_enrich, payment_check · Public sink: summarize, translate, extract, extract_url, qc_licence, pkg_meta, homework_check, verify_business, web_search, company_enrich, company_fit, payment_check, sanctions_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
